title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Mathe Avenue in Interlachen, Florida, as the "Robert H. Jenkins, Jr. Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 100 Mathe Avenue in Interlachen, Florida, as the "Robert H. Jenkins, Jr. Post Office."

summary.headline: Names the Postal Service facility at 100 Mathe Avenue in Interlachen, Florida, the "Robert H. Jenkins, Jr. Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a local U.S. Postal Service facility in Interlachen, Florida, to honor Robert H. Jenkins, Jr. It changes only the official name used for the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018.
